'''Ukio''' was a well-known [[Agriworld/Legends|agriworld]] in the [[Ukio system/Legends|Ukio system]] of the [[Abrion sector/Legends|Abrion sector]] and the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Ukian/Legends|Ukians]]. It served as one of the top producers of foodstuffs for the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].

==Description==
[[File:Ukio-AoI.png|thumb|left|200px|Another view of Ukio.]]
Ukio was located within a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] [[Ukio system/Legends|of the same name]] in the [[Abrion sector/Legends|Abrion sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was situated on the [[Manda Merchant Route/Legends|Manda Merchant Route]], a [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] that connected it to [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]] and [[Molavar/Legends|Molavar]].<ref name="TEA" /> Ukio itself was a large, terrestrial [[Planet/Legends|planet]] with gentle winds, calm weather, and a mild climate, which featured virtually no seasonal variation due to the world's slow rotation and low axial tilt. It had a breathable [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] and light gravity. Ukio's land consisted of three major continents cut through by hundreds of rivers. An Ukian [[Standard day/Legends|day]] lasted 22 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|standard]] [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]] and an Ukian [[Standard year/Legends|year]] lasted 357 local [[Standard day/Legends|days]]<ref name="LCS" />

Ukio was one of the best-known and most efficient [[Agriworld/Legends|agricultural planets]] in its [[Sector/Legends|sector]], featuring a [[growing season]] which lasted most of its [[Standard year/Legends|year]] and ideal conditions for the production of grain and other foodstuffs. Ukio's surface, originally dominated by rolling hills and wild grasses, was almost entirely given over to food production, but still contained ample fallow land for future expansion of the industry. Hundreds of rivers provided natural irrigation, which was expanded through the use of technology which harnessed and diverted them. Ukian farmland was carefully cultivated and painstakingly maintained for maximum output, and crop rotation was required by law to prevent the destruction of arable land. The world was governed by the [[Overliege]], a hereditary monarch, and was defended by [[Planetary shield/Legends|planetary shields]], which were operated by the [[Ukian Defense Service]].<ref name="LCS" /> [[Sashasa]] was a [[City/Legends|city]] on Ukio.<ref name="HNN" />

==History==
===Early history and secession===
{{Quote|Many of the worlds that we service, our neighbors, have already seceded. It is most prudent for us to continue serving them as best as possible. Furthermore, removed from the burden of Republic tariffs and bureaucracy, we will actually see a rise in efficiency and, eventually, profits for our farmers.|Ukian Overliege Topas dosLa, shortly after his planet's secession|<ref name="HNN" />}}
[[File:LAATsOverUkio-AoI.png|thumb|left|200px|A Republic LAAT over Ukio in 21 BBY.]]
The region of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] surrounding Ukio was explored between [[15,000 BBY/Legends|15,000]] and [[8000 BBY]], and during the final years of the [[New Sith Wars]], it was within space controlled by the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Brotherhood of Darkness/Legends|Brotherhood of Darkness]].<ref name="TEA" /> During the [[Inter-Sith Wars period]], a vast agricultural district was the site of an archaeological excavation after ground samples revealed synthetical debris. It was believed that an old settlement lies beneath the acreage.<ref name="Harvest">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Archaeology|Secret Harvest}}</ref>
Ukio was later part of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and provided a sizeable percentage of food shipments to the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] by [[23 BBY/Legends|23 BBY]], but in [[22 BBY/Legends|the following year]], the world seceded from the Republic along with the rest of the Abrion sector. At the time, it was ruled by Overliege [[Topas dosLa]], who wanted his world to have better control over its exports and to no longer suffer under burdensome Republic tariffs.<ref name="HNN" /> When the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] began, Ukio was within space controlled by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]],<ref name="TEA" /> but this did not last thanks to [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]], who negotiated a personal entreaty that brought back the planet into the Republic. However, in the aftermath of the [[Battle of Ukio]], the planet was taken over by the [[Corporate Alliance/Legends|Corporate Alliance]].<ref name="AoI" />

===Imperial Period and later history===
{{Quote|Perhaps one of the most technically demanding and ingenious attacks of the war was launched against the planet Ukio. Ukio, one of the New Republic's key agricultural production facilities, was conquered by the Empire with its shield generators ''intact''.|Voren Na'al, Director of New Republic Council Research|<ref name="LCS" />}}
[[File:BattleOfUkio.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Ukio is attacked during the Thrawn campaign.]]
Ukio was later part of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], and many native [[Human/Legends|Humans]] joined the military, including [[Corporal/Legends|Corporal]] [[Oberk]] and [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Narthax]].<ref name="CCG">{{CCG|set=Special Edition Limited|cardname=Sergeant Narthax}}</ref> Ukio eventually fell into the hands of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], where it served in the top five of planets for food production,<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|III|277|Ukio}}</ref> but was later [[Battle at Ukio|attacked]] by [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] during his [[Thrawn campaign|campaign]] against the New Republic. This was where he first used the trick, coordinated by [[Joruus C'baoth]], of firing [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] blasts at the [[Deflector shield/Legends|shields]] and having cloaked ships, which had sneaked in with the planetary shields down, to fire. This caused the appearance that Thrawn was firing through the shields, and Ukio surrendered.<ref name="Last">''[[The Last Command]]''</ref>
